customfield_10838.name: Steps to Reproduce
customfield_10838.note: Same quirk as CR: metadata reports plain textarea/string, but create/edit rejects a string and requires ADF doc content. Use an orderedList — one listItem per step; steps with a visible result use a bold 'Expected:' lead-in; route/URL/query fragments use inline code marks.

constraints.note: Not surfaced by getJiraIssueTypeMetaWithFields — same undocumented constraint as CR. Unlike CR, 'most recent sibling ticket's parent' is not a safe default here: recent TARS bugs span multiple unrelated epics (e.g. TARS-1026 'webtarsthree MVP Post Launch' vs TARS-807 'webtarsthree RTB' vs a ticket's own pipeline epic like TARS-1350). Infer by matching the new ticket's domain/component to the sibling's summary, not just recency, and always confirm with the user before creating.

CORRECTED 2026-09-16: getJiraIssueTypeMetaWithFields (requiredFieldsOnly, id 7) reports Parent as required: false — but a live createJiraIssue with no parent was rejected with 'Must be linked to an Epic using the Parent field', same undocumented create-time-only constraint already known for Bug. The prior note here ('no parent constraint enforced at create time') was wrong/stale — do not trust that field's metadata for Story in TARS. Always infer and confirm a parent epic (Step 5/7) before create, same as Bug.

Internal Package Software.note: getJiraIssueTypeMetaWithFields (issueTypeId 11513, requiredFieldsOnly: false) surfaced only issuetype/project/summary/reporter as required — no custom fields, no parent constraint enforced at create time. Decision boundary (per user correction 2026-09-08, supersedes the original broader framing): ISP is a CODE change that is never seen running as deployed application code on PRD, AND is not the build/CI orchestration itself. Concretely: a Dockerfile's base image or pinned apt/dependency versions = ISP (defines what's baked into a build artifact). The pipeline definition that runs the build (.github/workflows/*.yml, Jenkinsfile) = NOT ISP — editing how the build runs is process tooling, route to Task (or Bug/Story if fixing a defect/adding a capability). Test files (*.test.*, specs) = NOT ISP even though they don't run on PRD either — those stay Story, test coverage is product work. Non-code changes (docs, ticket housekeeping, manual vendor-UI config) = NOT ISP — that's Task's job. Content is a documentation record (what changed, why, where it's consumed), not repro steps or testable AC in the usual sense. Description authored in markdown from templates/InternalPackageSoftware.md. Caveat: TARS-1434 was originally created as a plain Task and only reclassified to this type after the fact — when the new ticket's subject matches this boundary, create as this type from the start rather than defaulting to Task.
